name: clip2remote
description: Paste any file — zip, video, PDF, anything — from your Mac clipboard into a VS Code terminal, uploading it over Remote-SSH and inserting the remote path. Built for Claude Code and other terminal AI agents. macOS client only.

commands.title: Clip2Remote: Paste Clipboard File into Terminal

clip2remote.remoteDir.description: Directory on the remote host where pasted files are uploaded.

clip2remote.host.description: SSH host to upload to. Leave empty to derive it from the window's remote authority (recommended).

clip2remote.warnAboveBytes.description: Ask for confirmation before uploading a file larger than this (bytes). 0 disables the prompt.

clip2remote.ttlSeconds.description: Age at which uploaded files are removed by the 'Clean Up Uploaded Files' command.

clip2remote.reuseSshConnection.description: Multiplex ssh/scp over a shared control connection. Much faster for repeated pastes; disable if it conflicts with your ssh config.

clip2remote.trailingSpace.description: Append a space after the inserted path, so you can keep typing your prompt.

clip2remote.enableInLocalWindows.description: Also intercept paste in local (non-SSH) windows, inserting the file's local path. Off by default: in a local window Cmd+V is left entirely alone and behaves as stock VS Code.
